N00b-rotate-credentials.reassessment_2026_08_18: CLERK_SECRET_KEY was never DISCLOSED. The deleted route used it server-side in an Authorization header to api.clerk.com and never returned it; ?inspect=1 returned restrictions/invitations/allowlist only. An attacker had the key's CAPABILITIES through a proxy, not the key. So rotation is defence-in-depth, not incident response. The roster review and session revocation are the checks that would actually reveal a compromise, and they are now the priority.

N00c-pwa-lock-llm-proxy.blocked_on: INTEGRATION, not credentials. N00c changes callClaude from (messages,{system,tools,maxTokens}) to (template,{params,attachments}). N00f's assertNoUnredactedImages() walks message.content[] and identifies redacted blocks by WeakSet IDENTITY; under the new signature the client passes data-URL strings, so the guard loses its identity handle and degrades to the isRedactedPayload string check. Restoring that guarantee is a DESIGN change to a PHI control, not a merge conflict.

N00f-redact-before-upload.bounded_gap: PDFs bypass redaction BY DESIGN. prepareDoc() (components/NeuroRVU.jsx:209, called at :632) base64s application/pdf straight through to Anthropic. That path carries the HR consolidated report — the physician's own productivity and compensation, not patient data. PDF is the ONLY bypass and an AST check enforces it stays PDF-only. Tracked as N00g.
N00f-redact-before-upload.known_weakness: Staleness is detected by aspect ratio within 2%. A differently-laid-out screenshot with the same aspect ratio would be masked with stored geometry rather than re-prompting. N27 (layout profiles) supersedes this heuristic.

N00g-pdf-redaction-gap.reason: Opened from the N00f finding. Close only if a PDF ever carries patient identifiers; today the PDF path carries the physician's own HR report.
